thread:
samir: Heads-up: weird parsing issue in sample-app when jsonMode + fncall + token refresh coincide. Repro steps in a sec.
aj: curious, what's the symptom?
samir: network/log capture shows function_call.arguments arriving as a string (double-encoded) after auth refresh. Example from the wire:
```
{\"type\":\"function_call\",\"name\":\"place_order\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"sku_9\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}],\\\"meta\\\":{\\\"user\\\":\\\"u9\\\"}}\"}
```
samir: arguments should be an object, not a quoted string. Only happens when refresh triggers retry.
maria: seen this on JS sample app. Python SDK tests don't show it since py sends bytes earlier. Definitely a parity gap.
jen: where is the retry middleware implemented? sdk-core? sample layer?
aj: it's in sdk-core http client. My working theory: a serializer runs during retry (for logging/metrics) then the transport reserializes, so payload gets stringify(stringify(obj)).
kevin: I could reproduce by forcing a 401 on the first request. Local hack: setting request._serialized = true in the sample app prevents the second stringify (ugly but confirms cause).
aj: plan: add a guard in transport to skip serializing if body is a string or flagged. I'll open a small PR with an integration test that forces auth-refresh and validates wire payload.
maria: also add a clear contract in docs: transport expects final body as string/bytes; middleware must not mutate original object. Helps SDK parity.
jen: UX suggestion: when jsonMode+fncall detects arguments is a string, throw a helpful error suggesting auth/retry double-serialize rather than a generic parse error.
kevin: +1. low friction, big DX win for onboarding.
dev-bot: CI for pr #4321: auth-retry-serialize-guard triggered 
js-integration/auth-refresh-args-check: failed (replicates double-encode)
aj: will iterate on the test and the guard. Might need to also avoid running stringify when computing header hashes for metrics.
samir: adding a short troubleshooting blurb for sample-app README so trial users can self-diagnose.
``
Troubleshooting: if you see "arguments" as a JSON string in logs:
 - Cause: retry/auth-refresh path double-serialized the request body
 - Workarounds: pin token refresh to synchronous path in sample app or upgrade to SDK patch when released
 - Dev hint: look for middleware that calls JSON.stringify on an already-string body
```
maria: filing a follow-up to audit py/js transport parity; assign to platform-infra.
kevin: action items: aj -> PR & tests, platform-infra -> parity audit, devex -> README blurb + improved error. Keep thread open until PR lands.
samir: thanks all, ping me for the repro workspace.
